guideItems.q: What size of pour-over kettle should I pick?
guideItems.a: 400 to 600 ml for one person, 800 ml or more if two or three of you drink coffee daily. A bigger kettle is harder to control at the end of the pour, so bigger is not better.

guideItems.q: Can ceramic cups go in the dishwasher?
guideItems.a: Smooth glazed cups can, on the top rack. Stoneware and pieces with wooden parts are better washed by hand and dried.

guideItems.q: Does linen shrink in the wash?
guideItems.a: It is preshrunk before it ships, so normal cold washing shrinks it less than 3%. Wash it alone the first time and dry it in the shade.

guideItems.q: Brass and copper change colour. Is that a flaw?
guideItems.a: No. Copper darkens slowly with use. A soft cloth and a little lemon juice brings the shine back, or leave it: that is how it ages.

guideItems.q: Can I add a card when it is a gift?
guideItems.a: Choose gift wrapping at checkout and write what you want to say in the notes. We write it on a card by hand and leave the price out.

guideItems.q: When will a sold out piece be back?
guideItems.a: Handmade pieces come in small batches, usually restocked in two to four weeks. The product page gives the expected date, and you can save it until then.
Orders before 16:00 leave our Hangzhou warehouse the next day. Around Shanghai and Zhejiang it takes 1 to 2 days, elsewhere 2 to 4.

guideItems.q: What if it arrives with a flaw?
guideItems.a: Write to us within seven days with a photo. We pay the shipping, and you choose a replacement or a refund.
